def transform(grid):
    # The left panel is a sequence of framed pattern rows; right panel patterns
    # are mapped by shape to the corresponding left-panel color/pattern.
    # Output consists of recolored left-panel frame and patterned interiors.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Each horizontal panel is delimited by full rows of frame color.
    frame = grid[0][0]
    cuts = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == frame for v in grid[r][:5])]
    # Left-side known patterns, converted cell-for-cell to their replacement colors
    # via matching pattern on the right side; right objects sorted top-to-bottom.
    segments = [(cuts[i], cuts[i+1]) for i in range(len(cuts)-1)]
    # Output retains left panel only, recoloring each interior shape according to
    # the right-side object's color, with an object-shape correspondence.
    out = [row[:5] for row in grid]
    # Right-side objects correspond to left-side pattern regions; mapping is
    # inferred by shape: matching interior pattern shape in each paired segment.
    for (a,b) in segments:
        left = [grid[r][:5] for r in range(a,b+1)]
        # right shape within same horizontal band (aligned rows)
        rightcols = [c for c in range(5,w) if any(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in range(a,b+1))]
        if not rightcols: continue
        color = next(grid[r][c] for r in range(a,b+1) for c in range(5,w) if grid[r][c] != 0)
        # Replace frame/background holes inside the left pattern with this color
        for r in range(a,b+1):
            for c in range(5):
                if grid[r][c] == 0:
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); frame=grid[0][0]
    split=next(c for c in range(1,w) if all(row[c]==0 for row in grid))
    cuts=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==frame for v in grid[r][:split])]
    def norm(cells):
        if not cells:return None
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
        return frozenset((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells)
    mapping={}
    for a,b in zip(cuts,cuts[1:]):
        holes=[(r-a-1,c) for r in range(a+1,b) for c in range(split) if grid[r][c]==0]
        cells=[(r-a-1,c-split-1) for r in range(a+1,b) for c in range(split+1,w) if grid[r][c]!=0]
        if holes and cells:
            color=next(grid[r][c] for r in range(a+1,b) for c in range(split+1,w) if grid[r][c]!=0)
            mapping[norm(holes)]=color
    out=[row[:split] for row in grid]
    # For each patterned region, use the color whose right object has the
    # same occupied-cell shape; holes are replaced, and the frame remains.
    for a,b in zip(cuts,cuts[1:]):
        holes=[(r-a-1,c) for r in range(a+1,b) for c in range(split) if grid[r][c]==0]
        # catalogs are indexed by shape of complement-hole pattern; same shapes
        # irrespective of which band contains the right-hand reference.
        color=mapping.get(norm(holes))
        if color is not None:
            for r,c in [(r,c) for r in range(a+1,b) for c in range(split) if grid[r][c]==0]: out[r][c]=color
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); frame=grid[0][0]
    split=next(c for c in range(1,w) if all(row[c]==0 for row in grid))
    cuts=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==frame for v in grid[r][:split])]
    # right objects are connected same-color components; crop their bounding boxes
    objects=[]; seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(split+1,w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=q[0]<h and split<q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==color:
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); c0=min(x for y,x in cells)
            objects.append((color,frozenset((y-r0,x-c0) for y,x in cells)))
    out=[row[:split] for row in grid]
    for a,b in zip(cuts,cuts[1:]):
        # interior void pattern, normalized to its bounding box
        holes=[(r,c) for r in range(a+1,b) for c in range(split) if grid[r][c]==0]
        if not holes: continue
        r0=min(r for r,c in holes); c0=min(c for r,c in holes)
        pattern=frozenset((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in holes)
        color=next((col for col,sh in objects if sh==pattern),None)
        if color is not None:
            for r,c in holes: out[r][c]=color
    return out
PY
